articles.summary: Kodiak AI and Roehl Transport launch autonomous freight service between Dallas and Houston, running four times per week using the Kodiak Driver autonomous system.
articles.title: Kodiak Begins Hauling Freight Autonomously With Roehl Transport

articles.summary: Kodiak AI announces a pilot with West Fraser to deploy autonomous trucks for timber hauling on remote resource roads in Alberta, Canada — marking Kodiak's first international operations.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Launches International Autonomous Trucking Operations and Enters Logging Industry

articles.summary: Kodiak AI commented on the bipartisan BUILD America 250 Act, proposed legislation that would create a federal regulatory framework for autonomous truck deployment and safety oversight.
articles.title: Kodiak AI Issues Statement on BUILD America 250 Act Bill Supporting Autonomous Trucks

articles.summary: Kodiak AI and General Dynamics Land Systems are collaborating to deploy the Kodiak Driver across ruggedized military platforms, with their first joint vehicle being the Leonidas Autonomous Ground Vehicle for counter-drone operations.
articles.title: Kodiak AI and General Dynamics Land Systems Form Strategic Collaboration For Autonomous Ground Vehicles
